id.description: ID of the redemption option to be used at reward points exchange

name.description: Name of the redeem option that can be presented to customer

description.description: Description of the redeem option that can be presented to customer

points.description: Points to deduct from customer's account at coupon creation

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the redeem option has been created.

modifiedAt.description: Timestamp when the redeem option has been modified.

discountType.description: 'PERCENT' for relative values, 'ABSOLUTE' for float values referring to a specific currency, 'FREE_SHIPPING' for reducing the shipping cost to 0.

discountPercentage.description: Discount percentage within a range [0.00, 100.00]. Must be specified only if type is 'PERCENT'.

discountAbsolute.title: Money Amount
discountAbsolute.description: Must be specified only if type is 'ABSOLUTE'

amount.description: Total amount in the specified currency.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g.: USD, EUR, CHF

allowAnonymous.description: Defines if the coupon can be redeemed by anonymous users

maxRedemptionsPerCustomer.description: Maximum number of redemptions per customer; -1 designates 'unlimited'. Cannot be specified for coupons which can be redeemed by anonymous users.

issuedTo.description: Id of the customer who originally received the coupon (seller-only).

redemptionCount.description: The number of times a specific coupon has been redeemed. Read-only, set through server. (seller-only)

status.description: Current status of the coupon (read-only). 'INACTIVE': the coupon is only valid in the future; 'VALID': can be used; 'EXPIRED': the coupon validity period has expired; 'USED': the maximum number of redemptions for the coupon has been reached.

links.description: Hypermedia reference to coupon actions (read-only, customer-only)

type.description: Content type of the referenced resource

deleted.description: Flag to mark a coupon as deleted (a.k.a. Soft delete). It is a read-only and seller-only attribute

validFor.description: A list of identifiers of customers that can redeem the coupon. Cannot be specified for coupons which can be redeemed by anonymous users.

validFrom.description: Must be provided in the ISO 8601 format (http://www.iso.org/iso/home/standards/iso8601.htm), e.g. '2015-01-31T23:59:59.999Z'

validUntil.description: Must be provided in the ISO 8601 format (http://www.iso.org/iso/home/standards/iso8601.htm), e.g. '2015-01-31T23:59:59.999Z'

minOrderValue.title: Money Amount
minOrderValue.description: Minimum order value which entitles the customer to redeem the coupon

amount.description: Total amount in the specified currency

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g.: USD, EUR, CHF
